title: The 5 Largest Empires in History, Ranked (#1 Covered a Quarter of Earth)

scenes.text: The Roman Empire isn't on this list. Number one covered about a quarter of all land on Earth.

scenes.label: Spanish Empire · 13.7M km²
scenes.text: Number five: the Spanish Empire. Thirteen point seven million square kilometers at its peak, around the year eighteen ten.

scenes.label: Qing dynasty · 14.7M km²
scenes.text: Number four: China's Qing dynasty. Fourteen point seven million square kilometers, reached around seventeen ninety.

scenes.label: Russian Empire · 22.8M km²
scenes.text: Number three: the Russian Empire. Twenty-two point eight million square kilometers, stretching across eleven time zones.

scenes.label: Mongol Empire · 24M km²
scenes.text: Number two: the Mongol Empire. About twenty-four million square kilometers, all of it connected, built on horseback.

scenes.label: British Empire · 35.5M km²
scenes.text: Number one: the British Empire. Thirty-five point five million square kilometers in nineteen twenty. About a quarter of the planet's land.

description:
The five largest empires in history, ranked by land area at their peak.
The Roman Empire covered about five million square kilometers, not even close to this list.
Which empire surprised you most?
first_comment: Which empire do you think was strongest, not just biggest? And what should we rank next?
